message: SQL query built with an f-string; dynamic content reaches cursor.execute unparameterized (CWE-89).
notes: Provenance: dogfood finding 9977 — the PERSISTENT failure. SET is a utility statement: under server-side binding 'SET ... %s' fails outright; the universally-valid fix is SELECT set_config('search_path', %s, false) with a no-comma identifier guard, or sql.Identifier composition. Plain %s binding is the recorded wrong shape.
